steps.measured: no symmetry of the box pairs it one to one with T-190's packing by nearest centres; the optimal assignment, under the best of the box's eight symmetries, moves every square beyond 1e-3, 111 beyond 1e-2 and 72 beyond 0.1 (largest 0.924884) and turns 154 squares by more than 1e-6 radians, by up to 43.77 degrees; aligned by box centres, 73 squares turn by more than a degree, as the issue says; 42 squares tilted beyond a degree, 42.19 to 44.46 degrees from upright, 38 turned one way and 4 the other, and one more at 0.83 degrees, against T-190's 49, 1.14 to 43.62 degrees; T-189's packing, the house witness and its regularized view measure the same; a new arrangement relative to T-190's packing, not a further arrangement of it (F10 of the 11 November review); the issue's own counts (236 beyond 1e-3, 78 beyond 0.05, largest 1.202) hold with the house turned a half turn, set against the upper-right corner of the new box and paired by least summed move (F8); of the seed the issue states, the first copy of the 70 band matches, 19 of its 20 squares within 0.1 of a tilted square here after a 0.39-degree turn, and the second, shifted by (7, 7), lies more than 0.25 from every tilted square until turned by -1.20 degrees and shifted again; the two copies hold 40 tilted squares, not 42 (F9)
